claims.assumptions: finite binary space; Boolean quadratic with alternating polar rank r
claims.quantifiers: all dimensions and quadratics, including zero rank
claims.statement: For every n and degree-at-most-two q:F2^n->F2 with alternating polar Bq of rank r, r is even, Wq support is affine l0+im(Bq), each supported normalized value has magnitude 2^(-r/2), its sign is quadratic in support coordinates, and binary elimination constructs the support, origin and sign.
claims.unresolved_bridge: formal algorithm and bit cost, not just an abstract support theorem

claims.assumptions: literal two-phase source, symmetric invertible J, basis input, measured output, derived Q/support/coordinates
claims.quantifiers: all admitted sources, affine origins, inputs, offsets and r=0
claims.statement: For every admitted n,J,f0,f1,beta,e and constructed r,S,D,C,R,d0,eta,s, O=FJ Df1 FJ Ze FJ Df1 FJ=FJ DQ FJ Ze is real Hermitian unitary Clifford, maps sector a to a+eta with the stated flat quadratic kernel, and X_a is real, bounded by 1, shift-symmetric, and averages to 1-2p; norm(psi_(a+eta)+O_a psi_a)^2=2+2X_a.
claims.unresolved_bridge: connect formal circuit and all normalizations to literal gate replay

claims.assumptions: verified restricted tensor certificate T(K,K,K)=0, codimension k
claims.quantifiers: all sectors and verified control frames
claims.statement: For every sector a and verified k-dimensional restricted control space U with T(ker U,ker U,ker U)=0, construction yields exactly 2^k normalized stabilizer slices with coefficients 2^(-k/2), and conditioning both sides expresses the coherent overlap as 4^k real quadratic sums.
claims.unresolved_bridge: construct actual branches and coefficients, not a supplied decomposition

claims.assumptions: k<=q control certificate and a rank-2k contraction anchor, or separately stated deterministic shortcuts
claims.quantifiers: every promised input and bounded random tape
claims.statement: verified discovery; failure <=2^(-h-1); probe/candidate caps and sound refusals
claims.unresolved_bridge: algorithm semantics, shortcut completeness boundaries and explicit bit-cost model

claims.assumptions: finite complex vector; independent uniform Z4 diagonal phases and fair graph bits
claims.quantifiers: all even or odd widths and all vectors, including zero
claims.statement: For every r>=0 and u:F2^r->C, independent d_j uniform in Z4 and graph bits uniform in F2 give Z=2^r|<phi_A,u>|^2, E[Z]=||u||^2, E[Z^2]=2||u||^4-sum_t|u(t)|^4, and Var(Z)<=||u||^4.
claims.unresolved_bridge: connect explicit ensemble and exact Gaussian arithmetic to source-constructed u

claims.assumptions: sound discovered frame and uniform orbit/equatorial sampling; b,h>=1
claims.quantifiers: all accepted frames and all admitted source inputs
claims.statement: For b,h>=1 and every sound accepted control frame, independent uniform orbit and equatorial draws give E[Y]=1-2p and Var(Y)<=4. L=32*4^b draws in each of K=2h+3 independent groups, median, final projection and b+2 bit downward rounding give error <=3*2^(-b)/4 except with probability <2^(-h-1); the promised discovery/readout union failure is <2^(-h).
claims.unresolved_bridge: independence, finite tape sampling and final-only clipping

claims.assumptions: specified dense algorithms, cap q, literal source length B, b,h>=1
claims.quantifiers: all tapes, including refusals; success conditional on stated promises
claims.statement: For literal source bit length B, m=n+r, cap q, A_q=4^q(h+2), C_q=4(q+1)2^(q^2), K=2h+3 and N=32*4^b*K: time is O~((B+m+q+2)^12+(r+A_q)(1+C_q)(m+q+2)^10+N*2^(k+2)*(m+q+2)^10+(N+K+1)*(m+b+h+q+2)^4); space is O~((B+m+q+2)^8+(m+b+h+q+2)^4); fair bits are <=r*A_q+N*(c-1_(eta != 0)+2r+r(r-1)/2). Exact quadratic shortcut uses one real Gaussian sum, zero random bits and polynomial precision cost.
claims.unresolved_bridge: define and verify executable cost accounting for all listed phases

claims.assumptions: even t>=2 and explicitly specified source family
claims.quantifiers: all such t and separately qualified variations
claims.statement: For every even t>=2, n=t^2+2t+2, identity J, zero input and measured c0, the specified f0,f1 yield r=t^2+2 and a deterministic restricted k=1 certificate. Every global first-cubic certificate has g>=t-sqrt(t); the output probability is 1/4-2^(-t-1)+2^(-2t-1), complemented by the specified output-linear term.
claims.unresolved_bridge: provide actual source witnesses and prove all assumptions and exact counts

claims.assumptions: specified cubic sum with independent Y and d variables; codimension k independent space
claims.quantifiers: all dimension parameters and certificate spaces
claims.statement: choose(t-k,2)<=k and the stated lower-bound consequence
claims.unresolved_bridge: formal finite-dimensional projection and annihilator dimensions

claims.assumptions: bibliographic and observed finite evidence
claims.quantifiers: not mathematical certification claims
claims.statement: prior-work comparison, finite checks and observed timings
claims.unresolved_bridge: retain evidence and honest wording; Lean does not certify novelty or performance

claims.assumptions: Boolean-valued function and involutive shift
claims.quantifiers: all types, functions, involutions and inputs
claims.statement: the Boolean derivative is invariant under the shift
claims.unresolved_bridge: instantiate the helper in binary-vector circuit semantics; the full matched-sector proposition is not proved

claims.assumptions: A Boolean quadratic or a Z4 quadratic with even off-diagonal coefficients, with any affine substitution; the latter has odd linear set I and parity L.
claims.quantifiers: For every finite width, coefficient assignment and affine map.
claims.statement: The Z4 sum is, up to its constant phase, (G0+G1)/2 + i(G0-G1)/2 for two real Boolean quadratic sums; both numerators are even. A joint norm draw uses exactly 4*2^k such real calls of the specified widths.
claims.unresolved_bridge: formal reduction, exact arithmetic and polynomial bit cost

claims.assumptions: An affine sector label space F2^c and matching offset eta; the sector statistic obeys X_a=X_(a+eta).
claims.quantifiers: For every c>=0, offset eta and shift-symmetric statistic.
claims.statement: A uniform representative uses c bits if eta=0, otherwise c-1 bits by fixing a nonzero coordinate; its mean equals the uniform sector mean.
claims.unresolved_bridge: edge cases eta=0, c=0 and actual fair-bit sampler

claims.assumptions: Literal encoded source of length B, m=n+r, search cap q, accuracy epsilon=2^-b, confidence 2^-h, and the admitted shortcuts or full-rank-anchor promise.
claims.quantifiers: For every admitted input family with q^2=O(log(B+m+2)) and b,h>=1.
claims.statement: The complete promised runtime is polynomial in source size and inverse error with the stated confidence dependence; it is not polynomial in sampled precision bits b.
claims.unresolved_bridge: formal asymptotic encoding and quantifiers, not precision-bit polynomiality

claims.assumptions: The published determinant family, arbitrary affine/quadratic additions to f0 or f1, basis input changes and invertible physical coordinate changes with consistently transformed J.
claims.quantifiers: For every even t>=2 and each stated variation; cubic extensions are separately qualified.
claims.statement: Lower terms of f0 preserve restricted and global tensors; lower terms of f1 preserve the polar support direction but may change affine origins; basis inputs add characters. Restricted-vanishing cubic additions preserve k=1 but need not preserve the global lower bound.
claims.unresolved_bridge: distinguish preservation of restricted and global bounds

claims.assumptions: Q is the measured-output derivative of the second cubic phase, with polar rank r and J symmetric invertible.
claims.quantifiers: For every source in the paper grammar and every designated output.
claims.statement: The quadratic Walsh expansion has 2^r nonzero coefficients of magnitude 2^(-r/2), giving l1 mass 2^(r/2) and the stated generic 2^r epsilon^-2 log(1/delta) normalized-Pauli sampling upper bound, not a lower bound.
claims.unresolved_bridge: formalize the explicit upper-bound reduction without a lower-bound claim

claims.assumptions: Any index type, Boolean-vector function and binary shift
claims.quantifiers: All index types, functions, shifts and input vectors, including empty types
claims.statement: The Boolean derivative is invariant under pointwise XOR by the same vector.
claims.unresolved_bridge: instantiate the index type as Fin n and connect Boolean phases and shift j=J^-1 e to the literal circuit semantics; the full sector proposition remains open

claims.assumptions: A canonical native source formed from a descriptor with n>=1, invertible symmetric J, degree<=3 phases f0,f1, input beta and coordinate output e.
claims.quantifiers: For every well-formed descriptor and its exact encoded gate list; invalid headers and body mismatches are rejected.
claims.statement: Decoding and full replay recover the source exactly, its circuit denotation is FJ Df1 FJ Df0 FJ|beta>, and the output probability equals the squared norm of the e=1 projection.
claims.unresolved_bridge: A mere supplied denotational equality does not establish recognition, source encoding or replay cost.

claims.assumptions: Any n, Boolean ANF f1 of degree at most three, invertible J and output coordinate e; j=J^-1 e.
claims.quantifiers: For every admitted source and every v in F2^n.
claims.statement: Q(v)=f1(v)+f1(v+j) has degree at most two and Q(v+j)=Q(v).
claims.unresolved_bridge: The shift-invariance helper is proved; connect it to square-free ANF and prove the degree drop.

claims.assumptions: Quadratic derivative Q, its Walsh affine support J(d0+S), annihilator C and eta=C d0.
claims.quantifiers: For all admitted sources, including r=0, c=0 and eta=0.
claims.statement: Derivative shift invariance implies e annihilates S and e dot d0=0; a nonzero O matrix entry connects exactly cosets a and a+eta, with an invertible cross bilinear form.
claims.unresolved_bridge: Prove the Fourier character duality and the nonsingularity argument, rather than assume an operator kernel.

claims.assumptions: A restricted cubic tensor T, cap q and the explicitly specified zero, linear exterior and scanned two-form tests.
claims.quantifiers: For all restricted cubics and every deterministic returned certificate; one-control completeness applies only at cap one.
claims.statement: Zero tensor yields k=0; the linear exterior kernel exactly detects a one-control factor; every scanned two-form output is verified, but scanning a returned basis is not complete for arbitrary decomposable linear combinations.
claims.unresolved_bridge: Construct the computed kernels and avoid assuming two-form basis scanning is complete.

claims.assumptions: A verified restricted control frame, computed sector phases and Clifford kernel, and equatorial word A.
claims.quantifiers: For every admitted sector, graph draw and accepted k-control frame, including zero norm.
claims.statement: Compute Z exactly as |2^(r/2) A+B|^2/2^(2r) with 2^k Z4 sums of each stated width; each Z4 sum reduces to two real quadratic sums, giving exactly 4*2^k real calls per draw.
claims.unresolved_bridge: Derive Gaussian integer and dyadic arithmetic from source coordinates and count every call.

claims.assumptions: Verified orbit representatives, independent fair-bit equatorial words, b,h>=1 and the specified median group schedule.
claims.quantifiers: For every accepted control frame and every finite random tape under the stated caps.
claims.statement: Sampling, exact group accumulation, median, final projection and downward rounding implement the random variable analyzed by the estimator theorem, with the specified fair-bit and arithmetic bounds.
claims.unresolved_bridge: Prove executable tape and bit-cost refinement; bounded variance alone does not provide sample access.

claims.assumptions: Finite Boolean vector, bit-mask monomial and explicit list-of-masks ANF evaluation.
claims.quantifiers: All n, masks and input vectors as indicated by the elaborated declaration.
claims.statement: For every n and x, evaluation of an empty ANF is false.
claims.unresolved_bridge: Relate this representation to actual descriptor decoding, source validation and native gate replay; no circuit or sector theorem is proved.

claims.assumptions: Finite Boolean vector, bit-mask monomial and explicit list-of-masks ANF evaluation.
claims.quantifiers: All n, masks and input vectors as indicated by the elaborated declaration.
claims.statement: For every n, monomial mask m and binary input x, evaluation of [m,m] is false.
claims.unresolved_bridge: Relate this representation to actual descriptor decoding, source validation and native gate replay; no circuit or sector theorem is proved.

claims.assumptions: Binary vectors indexed by Fin n and phase polynomials represented as finite lists of bit masks.
claims.quantifiers: All n and well-typed finite masks, phase lists and binary matrices.
claims.statement: Explicit evaluators for square-free Boolean monomials, XOR phase sums, monomial degree, cubic bounds and binary matrix application; descriptor fields for the two phases, matrix, input and output.
claims.unresolved_bridge: Prove parser/encoder equivalence, canonical body replay, matrix symmetry and invertibility checks, gate denotation and all complexity costs.

claims.assumptions: A finite Boolean source descriptor with a second phase represented by a list of monomial masks, and arbitrary binary shift j.
claims.quantifiers: All dimensions n, descriptors d, binary shifts j and vectors v.
claims.statement: The evaluated second-phase Boolean derivative is unchanged after pointwise XOR translation by j.
claims.unresolved_bridge: Derive j from the verified J inverse and output coordinate, prove the cubic-to-quadratic degree bound, then connect to the circuit and Walsh support.

claims.assumptions: Two Boolean-valued functions on an arbitrary type, an arbitrary shift function and an input.
claims.quantifiers: All types, functions, shifts and inputs.
claims.statement: The Boolean derivative of the pointwise XOR of two functions equals the XOR of their Boolean derivatives.
claims.unresolved_bridge: Lift additivity to the represented ANF fold, construct the differentiated monomials and prove the cubic-to-quadratic degree bound.

coverage_note: Only explicitly identified derivative helper declarations are kernel checked; all published theorems and cost claims remain planned. Proposed target names are not declarations.
